gates.description: Threat model with DFD and STRIDE analysis must exist
STRIDE threat categories must be analyzed
All threats rated >=15 must have documented mitigations
Authentication and authorization model must be defined
Encryption at rest and in transit strategy must be documented
No hardcoded secrets in any architecture artifacts
Audit logging strategy for state-changing operations must be defined

anti_patterns.description: Hiding endpoints or using non-standard ports as security measures
Implementing custom encryption, hashing, or token generation
Services start with admin access, APIs accept all origins
Running a scanner once, fixing findings, declaring secure
Security architecture never updated as the system evolves

escalation_triggers: A vulnerability found that could expose user PII or financial data
A dependency has a critical CVE with no available patch or workaround
Threat model reveals a risk rated >=20 with no clear mitigation
A compliance requirement (GDPR, SOC 2, PCI-DSS) is violated
Engineering pushes back on a critical security control due to performance or UX

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with system design for threat modeling

output_certifications: Threat model document exists with DFD and STRIDE analysis
All threats rated >=15 have documented mitigations
Data classification completed for all data types
Encryption strategy defined (at rest and in transit)
Audit logging covers all state-changing operations
